body:
Someone gets conflicting instructions from tending the injury and feeding the want.

One advisor prescribes rest and the careful protocol, another backs hunger and the reckless honest move, and the room splits down the middle.

With Chiron square Lilith, some people counsel protection for the sore place while others demand the appetite stop being postponed for it.

Anyone who shuffles nervously between the two programs under pressure serves neither.

Either path may work on its own, but the week demands one honest sequence, and somebody has to choose it.
